trial.program_source:
def transform(grid):
 h=len(grid); w=len(grid[0]); out=[[0]*w for _ in range(h)]
 if min(h,w)<8:return out
 kh=h//3; kw=w//3
 for bottom in (False,True):
  for right in (False,True):
   pts=[(r,c,grid[r][c]) for r in (range(h-kh,h) if bottom else range(kh)) for c in (range(w-kw,w) if right else range(kw)) if grid[r][c]]
   if not pts:continue
   dr=h//2-min(r for r,c,v in pts) if bottom else h//2-1-max(r for r,c,v in pts)
   dc=w//2-min(c for r,c,v in pts) if right else w//2-1-max(c for r,c,v in pts)
   for r,c,v in pts:out[r+dr][c+dc]=v
 return out
